fields.description: DAMAC Bay 2 by Cavalli is the second Bay-branded waterfront release at Dubai Harbour. The developer describes a 49-storey collection of one- to five-bedroom homes, combining Cavalli-inspired interiors with swimming and wellness facilities.

research.community: DAMAC Bay 2 by Cavalli · Dubai Harbour
overview: The presentation distinguishes conventional luxury apartments from larger super-luxury residences. Its specification includes fitted kitchens and built-in wardrobes, while the typical plans illustrate different balcony shapes and positions. Furniture shown in imagery should not be assumed to form part of the purchase.
research.locationNote: DAMAC places Bay 2 in Dubai Harbour opposite Dubai Marina, within the waterfront district between Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters. Confirm the actual tower, entrance and beach-access arrangements for the chosen home.
research.priceNote: The original tower A inventory table starts at AED 2.99 m; tower B starts at AED 3.08 m. These dated marketing references do not represent current stock. Property Finder’s later headline is around AED 7.3 m and another broker advertises a different selection; obtain a current unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder’s 20/60/20 reference is shown below. The original presentation prints 24% immediately, twelve 4% quarterly stages, four 3% stages and 20% completion:104% in total. It does not explain the additional amount. Another broker gives 20/20/60. No fee assumption or normalization was made.
research.handoverNote: The original presentation says January 2028, Property Finder gives Q4 2028, and Casadior gives Q4 2027. These sources conflict; confirm the contractual date for the selected tower and unit.
